headline: Pakistan NationalGrid Plans Rs 100 Billion Sukuk Bond Issuance
summary: National-Grid Company of Pakistan issued a Request for Proposals to appoint lead managers for a Shariah-compliant Sukuk program of up to Rs 100 billion to expand power transmission networks.
why: Sukuk issuances represent a major sovereign-adjacent capital raising tool across Islamic finance markets, funding large-scale public infrastructure projects.

impacts.name: Pakistan
impacts.why: Capital raising through Sukuk debt supports utility infrastructure expansion.
